_readme: One halftone photograph per featured website, keyed by the directory resource id (data/resources/<id>.json). directory.js shows images[<featured id>] beside the red 'Recently added' band and builds the footer credit from the same entry. A featured website with no entry here gets NO photograph (never another site's). Add entries only by following tools/FEATURED_IMAGE_WORKFLOW.md. Paths are relative to the site root; masters live in images/resources/_masters/ (not published).

gapminder.attribution_requirements: CC BY 4.0: credit the creator (Zoriah Miller), link the licence, say the image was changed, keep any notices. Commercial use and adaptation are allowed. No 'NoDerivatives' or 'NonCommercial' term applies.
gapminder.change_note: Adapted by Free Range Tutors: cropped and printed as a black halftone on a transparent background.
gapminder.notes: Zoriah Miller is listed as the photographer on the Dollar Street page and in the image record (photographer.slug zoriah-miller). Dollar Street home 'Family 7', Haiti, visited 2014-11-28; topic 'Cooking pots'. The photograph shows pots and bowls and no people. Source file 2700 x 1800 px. Chosen over six other Dollar Street home photographs tried through the script (including a lamp): its ink coverage (58%, 35% transparent) is the closest to the Holyoke original (61%, 30% transparent), so it keeps the same open, see-through feel; the bright bowls rise into the cream area. Halftoned with tools/make_feature_halftone.py (default centre focus, no manual settings).
